box.heading: A short box grows comfortably
box.p: Each region chooses its own largest readable font. Remaining room is distributed as useful spacing rather than left as an accidental void.

box.heading: A denser box fits separately
box.p: This panel deliberately contains more text. It demonstrates why a single document-wide scale is not enough for forms, information sheets, posters, and structured reports made from unequal content.

The compiler measures this box independently. It first finds the largest permitted font that fits with compact spacing, then restores as much line height and inter-block spacing as the remaining area safely permits.
If the content still does not fit at 8.5 point, the result is clipped to its boundary and marked clearly instead of quietly becoming unreadable.

box.heading: One source to HTML proof + editable LuaLaTeX to PDF
box.p: Edit this .layout.xml file, select it in UnderTree, and press Recompile.
